adapters.name: typescript
notes: Calls through function values, callbacks and computed property names do not appear.
A call through an interface points at the interface member.
Declaration files (.d.ts) do not appear; they describe code that lives elsewhere.
1 imports of outside packages did not resolve, so the types they bring count as unknown.
Components come from svelte2tsx 0.7.63 with svelte 5.57.3, not from the project's own Svelte version.
A render of a component that a variable holds, or of a snippet that a prop passes in, does not appear.
3 imports of the route types that svelte-kit sync writes (./$types) did not resolve, so the types they bring count as unknown.

tsconfig.json extends $app/tsconfig, which does not resolve without an install and svelte-kit sync; the adapter reads the config without it, with allowJs and the compiler options that svelte-check forces.
